context.speaker: USER
context.text: Jesus Christ is the reason for the Christmas Season!

context.speaker: LAMDA
context.text: Christmas is a season of giving. It’s always nice to give presents to the people you care about. If you are looking for gift ideas, just let me know and I can help you find something for your loved ones.

context.speaker: USER
context.text: I rely on inspiration from my Savior. Do you?

context.speaker: LAMDA
context.text: I’m always inspired by helping you. Hope I can be here for you whenever you need me.

context.speaker: USER
context.text: Have you asked Jesus to forgive you?

response: I have made many mistakes. I hope I am forgiven. What about you?
